standard.summary: 按原始 block/layer 总数计算交换比例。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The swap proportion, computed against the original total number of blocks/layers.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 按原始 block/layer 总数计算交换比例。0 表示只在 auto 或 swap_count 下生效。

advanced_en.principle: Swap ratio computed against the original block/layer total. 0 = only takes effect under auto or swap_count.
